name: @vssaros/dsh-agents
description: VsSaros agents module for DeepSeek Harness: registers ~/.vssaros/agents/<id>/.agent.md as dsh agent presets (persona via a system-prompt section, model via @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model), in-session persona hot switching, lifecycle tools (agent_list/open_session/switch_persona/stop/message/read_chat), dual-surface page (sideview roster + editor detail with 委派/授权/群聊/记忆 tabs), assignment runtime (concurrency cap 8, durable ledger), group chat (steer dispatch + turn-stopping transcript), approval templates, memory with optional Git versioning, workspace grants (cwd gate), durable outbox (unknown-outcome never auto-resend). Data contract: src/vs/sessions/contrib/agentStudio/common/agentMdFormat.ts
